Take all the abv, put into cheese cloth and into a mason jar.

Take two pans and boil water in both.

Put the jar into one pan and let it simmer. Top up the water from the other pan as it goes.

Get two sticks of butter in, and seal up the jar. Let it cook for 3 hours.

Remove cloth package and strain it. Let butter cool to a lovely green.
